variants.headline: Business plan abandoned before opening
variants.body: The founder {founder} has abandoned the plan for {business} before opening. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.

variants.headline: An intended company will not open
variants.body: The planned {business} will not open: {founder} has given up the plan. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.

variants.headline: A household's business plan ends
variants.body: The business plan made by {founder} has been abandoned before the company opened. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.
